about.name: Natalia Luz
about.bio: Attorney graduated from PUC/SP (2010), with over 14 years of experience in civil law and intellectual property. Natalia received her own Green Card in 2020 based on exceptional ability — and now dedicates her career to opening that same path for other Brazilian professionals.
